name: Eca AI Mail for Contact Form 7
author: ECA Tech Inc

sections.description:
Smart AI Mail connects your Contact Form 7 forms with an AI backend to automatically generate and send intelligent email responses to your visitors.

Features:

  • Automatically generates AI responses to CF7 form submissions
  • Sends personalized email replies to users
  • Summarize your website pages for better AI context
  • Admin panel to manage page summaries
  • Subscription management

External Services

This plugin connects to an external AI service to generate automated email replies and summaries.

Service: Ecaray AI Reply API (https://aireply.ecacode.com)

What the service does:
Processes Contact Form 7 submissions and page content to generate AI-based replies and summaries.

What data is sent:
– Form submission data (name, email, message)
– Page/post content (for summarization)
– User ID (if logged in)

When data is sent:
– On form submission
– When generating summaries

Terms of Service:
https://ecacode.com/terms-of-service

Privacy Policy:
https://ecacode.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/eca-ai-mail-for-contact-form-7/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Smart AI Mail in the admin menu
  4. Login with your ECA Code account to activate the plugin
  5. Add your information and select pages to summarize
sections.faq:
Do I need a Contact Form 7 plugin?

Yes, Contact Form 7 must be installed and activated.

Do I need an account?

Yes, you need an account at ecacode.com to use this plugin.
